stories.title: HMRC Launches Automatic Making Tax Digital Sign-Up from September 2026
stories.summary: HMRC has announced it will automatically enrol eligible taxpayers into the Making Tax Digital for Income Tax (MTD for IT) service from September 2026, writing to those affected with key dates.

stories.title: UK Finance Responds to HMRC Consultation on Stamp Taxes on Shares Modernisation
stories.summary: UK Finance has submitted its response to HMRC's consultation on modernising the Stamp Taxes on Shares framework, proposing a reformed Securities Transfer Tax regime.

stories.title: HMRC Closes Consultation on Modernising Taxation of Distributions
stories.summary: HMRC's consultation on modernising the taxation of distributions and repayments of capital from companies closed on 14 September 2026. Law firm Simmons & Simmons and other stakeholders have published their responses.

stories.title: MoD Base Asylum Plan Sparks Village Protest — Badenoch Visits Piddington
stories.summary: Kemi Badenoch visited an Oxfordshire village where residents held a symbolic referendum to 'leave the UK' in protest against Ministry of Defence (MoD) plans to house asylum seekers on a military base, with the Home Office's immigration policy under scrutiny.

stories.title: Home Office Releases Immigration Detention Statistics for Year Ending March 2026
stories.summary: The Home Office has published detailed immigration detention datasets for the year ending March 2026, covering people entering and leaving detention under immigration powers.

stories.title: UK Backs Adaptable UN Peace Operations at Security Council
stories.summary: The UK has stated at the UN Security Council that it stands ready to work with the UN to ensure peace operations remain adaptable, effective, and fit for modern challenges.

stories.title: British Virgin Islands Premier Leads Delegation to London for Constitutional Talks
stories.summary: BVI Premier Natalio D. Wheatley is leading a delegation to London from 21–26 September for constitutional negotiations with the UK government, managed under FCDO oversight.

stories.title: DWP Publishes Annual Benefits Statistics Compendium
stories.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions has released its Annual Benefits Statistics Compendium, providing comprehensive data on DWP-administered benefits for the latest reporting period.

stories.title: Evaluation Accelerator Fund Phase 5: Project Summaries Released
stories.summary: DWP has published summaries of projects awarded funding under Phase 5 of the Evaluation Accelerator Fund (EAF), which supports evaluating the effectiveness of public services.

agencies.name: DEFRA
agencies.description: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs

stories.title: DEFRA Provides £65m in Drought Grants for Farmers Amid Criticism
stories.summary: DEFRA has announced £65 million in drought relief grants for farms across England affected by drought conditions. Farmers and commentators have welcomed the aid but warn it 'won't go far' given the scale of losses.

stories.title: Updated Bluetongue Restricted Zone Livestock Movement Form Published
stories.summary: DEFRA and the Animal and Plant Health Agency have published an updated information request form (EXD645(GB)) for livestock movements from bluetongue restricted zones or temporary control zones to Scotland.

stories.title: South Ribble Reaches Cleaner Air Milestone Following DEFRA Recommendations
stories.summary: South Ribble Borough Council has achieved a cleaner air milestone, following DEFRA's recommendations after air quality monitoring showed pollution levels had improved sufficiently to lift restrictions.

stories.title: Over 114,000 Army Applications Rejected on Medical Grounds in Five Years
stories.summary: MoD data shows more than 114,000 applications to the British Army were rejected on medical grounds over the past five years, raising concerns about recruitment pipelines and the impact of childhood medical histories on career aspirations.

stories.title: MoD Publishes Land Open Systems Architecture (LOSA) Framework
stories.summary: The Ministry of Defence has published its Land Open Systems Architecture (LOSA) framework, setting out its approach to supporting the integration of land capabilities through open technical standards.

stories.title: Inquest into British Aid Workers Killed in Gaza May Call UK Military Chiefs
stories.summary: An inquest into the deaths of British aid workers killed in Gaza is expected to call on both Israeli and UK military chiefs to give evidence, putting MoD processes and communications under scrutiny.

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

stories.title: BIST Under Fire Over Lack of 'Credible Plan' for British Steel
stories.summary: The Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (BIST) has been criticised for not having a credible turnaround plan for British Steel, more than a year after taking the company into public ownership.

stories.title: New Statutory Right to Bereavement Leave Announced from April 2027
stories.summary: Ministers have announced a new statutory right to bereavement leave from April 2027, covering employees who lose a spouse, partner, parent, adult child or sibling — marking a significant employment rights expansion.

stories.title: ONS Develops AI Thematic Account to Measure AI's Impact on UK Economy
stories.summary: The Office for National Statistics has set out its methodology for compiling an AI thematic account to quantify artificial intelligence's contribution to and impact on the UK economy — a key data initiative aligned with BIST's AI strategy.

stories.title: Martha's Rule to Be Expanded to Every A&E in England
stories.summary: The NHS is expanding Martha's Rule — which gives patients and families the right to request an urgent second clinical opinion — to every Accident and Emergency department in England, following its initial rollout in hospitals.

stories.title: Report Urges NHS Red Tape Cuts to Prevent 20,000 Early Deaths a Year
stories.summary: A major independent report calls on the government to cut NHS red tape and boost productivity, arguing that failure to reform could result in 20,000 preventable deaths annually in England due to inefficiencies in care delivery.

stories.title: Royal Papworth and Cambridge University Hospitals to Share Epic Patient Record System
stories.summary: Royal Papworth Hospital and Cambridge University Hospitals are partnering to introduce a shared Epic electronic patient record system, enabling more joined-up care for patients seen at both trusts.

stories.title: Hartlepool Postal Delays Return — Residents Waiting Weeks for Letters
stories.summary: Concerns over Royal Mail services in Hartlepool have resurfaced, with residents once again reporting lengthy delays of several weeks for both first and second class mail, echoing previous delivery failures.

stories.title: 17 Days and Counting: Paisley Second Class Mail Still Not Delivered
stories.summary: A local investigation in Paisley has tracked eight pieces of second class mail posted on 4 September 2026 that had still not been delivered 17 days later, highlighting ongoing reliability issues with Royal Mail's second class service.

stories.title: TV Licence Savings Stamp Refunds to End December 2026 — Royal Mail Swap Scheme Still Open
stories.summary: TV Licensing has announced that refunds for old savings stamps end on 31 December 2026. Royal Mail is running a free 'Swap Out' scheme allowing customers to exchange old stamps at Post Office branches.
